disk_rule.check: Get-PSDrive C before every image call

visual_qa: Full-image review plus representative detail crops at 200%; no project previews kept.

images.initial_prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: an additional location key, exactly 1536x1024 landscape PNG at native resolution, full-bleed single image.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED covered market street. Draw its fish-lane extension as the same place: match the arched translucent pale-blue roof with dark metal ribs, weathered low shopfronts, plain retractable awnings, warm bare hanging bulbs, wet grey paving and saturated food/plastic-tub accents against muted blue evening. This is a narrower fish side lane off that arcade, about 2m clear walking width, not a new large warehouse.
Establishing view into the fish lane at evening, camera 1.6m above the paving, offset slightly left so the architecture is clearly readable. Foreground and middle-distance stalls on both sides hold clear rectangular glass tanks on solid stands and shallow white ice trays with small whole silver fish on crushed ice. Tank water has modest highlights; a few practical attached hoses and pipes, red/blue plastic tubs under counters. Avoid duplicated nonsense equipment. Maintain a clear 2m passage, tanks and trays around waist height, shop doors about 2.1m, railings 1.1m.
At picture-right in the middle distance, a clearly defined open cold-storage STAIRWELL recess with a firmly attached steel handrail and visible descending concrete steps leads beneath the stalls. An eerie restrained violet light emerges from below, lighting those stair treads and the adjacent wall edge; the source is out of view down the stairwell. It must read as steps descending underground, not a glowing shop doorway, not a portal slit and not a whole-image purple wash. Warm hanging bulbs remain the main key light, cool blue evening filters through the matching arcade roof, with local violet as the single new stairwell accent requested for this view. Wet paving reflects only the real bulbs and the nearby violet recess.
Exactly two tiny generic adult figures far down the lane for scale, full normal 7.5-head proportions and feet planted on the same paving; no large people or action. All signs and price tags entirely blank, no letters or numerals, no brands. Location-reference level background detail, continuous coherent roof ribs and stall perspective, crisp ink and clean hard cel shadows. No monsters, no trucks, no giant serpent. Crisp lossless image, no compression blocks or upscaled softness.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

attempts.qa: Matches the approved arched blue roof, awnings, warm bulbs and wet paving. Glass tanks, ice trays and a distinct locally violet-lit cold-storage stairwell are visible; two small adults, blank signboards.
